content:
Platforms: Windows
Indicates remote code execution on a domain controller using PsExec.
This event is generated based on a REMOTE_INTERACTIVE type ActiveDirectoryIncomingDceRpcEpmRequest event that correlates with an
ActiveDirectoryServiceAccessRequest event to the Common Internet File System (CIFS) or a host Service Principal Name (SPN).
This event replaces the ActiveDirectoryIncomingPsExecExecution event, which is now obsolete.
